title: Metrology Specialist (Starship)
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

METROLOGY SPECIALIST (STARSHIP)

Starship Metrology at Starbase supports production, test, and launch by keeping measuring and test equipment tracked, issued, and in spec. This role does the day-to-day admin work for the lab: tickets, inventory, vendors, shipping, notifications, audits, and reporting.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Handle lab requests for new IMTE( Inspection, Measuring, and Test Equipment ) additions, priority calibrations, on-site scheduling, and equipment issuing
  • Move equipment through the normal workflow, including status updates, customer check-in support, and vendor calibration processing
  • Keep customer inventory current and audit production-line equipment; flag equipment that is not operating or measuring correctly
  • Coordinate vendor POs, quotes, and invoices for repair and calibration
  • Send weekly overdue-asset notices to production teams
  • Coordinate shipping for SpaceX Metrology labs and vendor labs
  • Collect data on outsourced calibrations and in-sourcing ROI
  • Keep inventory, status, and ownership records current; help with calibration coordination, reporting, and audits
  • Reply to customers promptly and help walk-ins; act as the admin contact for users, production teams, and vendors
  • Help with documentation and process changes; work assigned priorities and update others on progress and blockers

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • High school diploma or equivalency certificate

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 1+ years of general admin or coordination experience
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel and Outlook)
  • Jira and/or Indysoft software systems
  • Calibration or inventory systems, vendor POs, shipping, or inventory control
  • Completing basic calibrations on gas meters and common hand tools (calipers, micrometers, tape measures, torque wrenches, crane scales, and similar)
  • Familiarity with ISO/IEC 17025, AS9100D, and ISO 9001
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to handle several tasks and deadlines at once
  • Experience writing reports, notices, and process docs
  • Clear writing and speaking

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted and to stand for extended periods
  • Flight hardware typically is built at height or in tight quarters, and physical dexterity is required
  • Ability to perform job duties that require standing, kneeling, crouching, twisting upper body, working in cramped positions in small openings, and climbing hand over hand
  • Must be able to work all shift hours, overtime, and weekends as needed
  • Must be able to travel for short trips as needed

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.
